newsitem.title: USA: United Dental to post charge.
newsitem.headline: United Dental to post charge.

text.p: Adding details to an earlier second quarter forecast, United Dental Care Inc said on Tuesday that it will post a charge of $4.2 million during the quarter related to a loss on Arizona Medicaid contracts.
The company is making changes to the provider panel to reduce the number of fee-for-service network providers, which will result in the charge.

United Dental said it estimates that the combined reduction in pre-tax income due to the write-off of the Medicaid contracts, the increased dental loss ratio on fee-for-service products and the other earnings effects will be $9.2 million for the six months ending June 30, 1997.
The company is still reviewing with its independent accountants whether some portion of this increase should be reflected in the first quarter of the current year, it said.
United Dental estimates that it will include in the second quarter results a reduction in pre-tax income of about $1.5 million, United Dental said.
On May 23, United Dental said it expected its earnings to be below Wall Street estimates from the company's Medicaid contract and higher claims expenses.
In last year's second quarter, United Dental reported earnings of $0.23 a share on sales of $26.3 million.
